title: New feedback is matched against old feedback, and a repeat is flagged
why: Owner, Nov 1 17:44 CST, forwarding a home repo session's finding: the gap is in every repo, not only home.
note: Shape: logging a feedback item searches the repo's old inboxes, roadmap and backlog, through the glossary of the owner's words against code names (the owner said carousel; the repo said wheel), and flags a repeat on the item. Today nothing is matched. Ready: no open question. Port: yes, every repo.
